title: Paloma and the Gravity
author: Coral Eastwick
blurb: Sebastian Winterbourne, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
